name: GoTalk
summary: Long-distance prepaid phonecard provider then telecom (gotalk Communications Pty Ltd, ACN 091 320 348; brand from ~2002); bought Wild IT's customer base 28 Mar 2007 ($240k); transferred post-paid services to ClubTelco ~late 2010, kept prepaid; ACCC undertaking 2008 re telemarketing.

events.details: Post-paid services to ClubTelco; prepaid retained.
